summary: Added server-side search to GET /?q=. Matching is case-insensitive substring on title or author, checked separately, on the trimmed term, with no RegExp, and it tolerates non-string or missing fields. The shelf page now has a labelled role=search GET form. Results show "N book(s) match" and a "Show the whole shelf" link, and keep Reserve links and reserved marks. A search with no match renders M5 (refusal first, then the form with q in the box and aria-describedby, then the link, no list). The term is escaped at every echo site. Added test/search.test.js with the two witnesses plus A3 escaping, the plausible-wrong-implementation checks, odd-field data and custom settings. Added a matching and a no-match search to floor.test.js flowPages. Outlined search button CSS added. Full suite 77/77 pass and witness-check passed. Not done: I did not run the server in a browser, so the 360px layout and the outlined button are unchecked visually.
notes: Quotes in titles/headings are emitted as " because esc escapes quotes everywhere; tests match that form.
Results page title is 'Books matching "{q}"' (design names none); singular is '1 book matches'.
The collection-window line (I-21) is not built here; the form sits at the top of <main> so the line can go above it later.
Search tests start servers with createApp; the A3 hit case uses a temp shelf whose title holds the payload.
